title: skills: teach the three data-model publish checks from #35143's Data model family (PR #37513)
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of an accepted delivery. PR #37513 (`Part of #35143`, Data model family) narrows publish and declares `Skills-docs: follow-up owed`; this card carries it.

## What the skills must teach

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`: a roll-up (summary) field's child object must point back to the parent (a lookup or master_detail to it, or `relationshipField`), or publish refuses it (`rollup/child-without-parent-reference`).
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`: `reference` is read only on lookup, master_detail, user, tree and summary; on any other type publish refuses it (`field/reference-on-non-reference-type`).
- `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`: `lockRecord` locks `master_detail` children only; a lookup child drawn as a body table stays editable while pending (advisory `approval-detail-editable-while-pending`).

## Done when

The three files teach the rules above, and the skill evals exercise them. Lands after PR #37513 merges.

Suggested-grade: p2 · published skills would teach authors to write metadata that publish now refuses.
Dedupe: `child-without-parent-reference skills` and `reference-on-non-reference-type` found only #35143 and PR #37513.
